summary: Clearway Energy LLC filed an 8-K disclosing that on October 1, 2026, subsidiary Honeycomb 2 Purchaser LLC signed a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement with Honeycomb 2 CE Seller LLC, an affiliate of Clearway Energy Group, to acquire membership interests in Honeycomb 2 TargetCo LLC for a base cash price of approximately $119 million, subject to financial-model adjustments. TargetCo will indirectly own Escalante BESS II, Escalante BESS III and Granite Mountain BESS West, three Utah battery storage projects totaling roughly 210 MW. At closing, Purchaser holds 100% of class A units and CEG affiliate Clearway Renew holds class C units. Closing is expected in Q4 2027; watch affiliate-governance, cost-overrun and permitting risk.
